input.overview: Faeton builds its payout through repeated drop-bank completions. Each drop scores 5,000 and advances Bonus. The first completed bank lights Double Bonus and the upper Extra Ball; the second lights Double Bonus, the lower Extra Ball, and Special. With Double Bonus lit, hit the red dynamite target to make Triple Bonus available. End-of-ball Bonus pays 10,000, 20,000, or 30,000 per step at single, double, or triple value.
input.simpleOverview: In Faeton, each drop target scores 5,000 and advances Bonus. Complete the bank once for Double Bonus and the upper Extra Ball, then again for the lower Extra Ball and Special. While Double Bonus is lit, hit the red dynamite target to open Triple Bonus. Bonus pays up to 30,000 per step at Triple Bonus.
input.summary: Keep returning to the drop bank because the first and second completions open every major award. Collect a lit Extra Ball before continuing the bank, and use the red dynamite target after Double Bonus lights so the accumulated Bonus can pay at Triple value.

steps.text: Knock down drop targets for 5,000 each and one Bonus advance.
Complete the bank once to light Double Bonus and the upper Extra Ball.
Collect the upper Extra Ball while it is lit; the lamp goes out after the collect.
Complete the bank a second time to light Double Bonus, the lower Extra Ball, and Special.
With Double Bonus lit, hit the red dynamite target to open Triple Bonus, then protect the built Bonus through the end of the ball.

alternatives.title: Bonus-first route
alternatives.when: Use this when the Extra Ball collect is unsafe but the bank remains available.

steps.text: Continue taking controlled drop-target hits to raise Bonus.
Secure Double Bonus on the first bank completion.
Hit red dynamite for the Triple Bonus opportunity before the ball drains.

buildsToward.title: Two Extra Balls, Special, and Triple Bonus

steps.text: Finish the bank once and collect the upper Extra Ball.
Finish it again for the lower Extra Ball and Special.
Use red dynamite after Double Bonus lights to reach the 30,000-per-step Triple Bonus payout.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play, Extra Ball and Special conversion, Double and Triple Bonus behavior, and score-threshold awards.
Test the full drop bank, upper and lower Extra Ball collects, red dynamite target, Special collect, Bonus lamps, and multiplier lamps.
